title: Scaling Curriculum Learning For Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2608.22549v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Batched simulators for autonomous driving have recently enabled training reinforcement learning (RL) agents at scale, encompassing thousands of traffic scenarios and billions of interactions within a matter of days. Although such high-throughput feeds RL algorithms faster than ever, their sample-efficiency has not kept pace: As the standard training scheme, domain randomization uniformly samples scenarios, thereby consuming a vast number of interactions on cases that contribute little to learning. Curriculum learning offers a remedy by adaptively prioritizing scenarios that matter most to policy improvement. We present CL4AD, the first integration of curriculum learning into batched autonomous driving simulators by framing scenario selection as an unsupervised environment design problem. translated_title: 自动驾驶中的课程学习扩展
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22549v1 公告类型：新 摘要：用于自动驾驶的批量模拟器最近使得在大规模上训练强化学习（RL）智能体成为可能，涵盖了数千个交通场景和数十亿次交互，仅需数天时间。尽管这种高吞吐量比以往更快地为RL算法提供数据，但其样本效率并未同步提升：作为标准训练方案，领域随机化均匀采样场景，从而在那些对学习贡献甚微的案例上消耗了大量交互。课程学习通过自适应地优先处理对策略改进最重要的场景提供了一种补救措施。我们提出了CL4AD，这是首次将课程学习集成到批量自动驾驶模拟器中，通过将场景选择构建为无监督环境设计问题。我们引入了效用函数，基于成功率和智能体行为的逼真度来塑造课程，此外还结合了现有的遗憾估计。
tldr: 本文提出了CL4AD，首次将课程学习集成到批量自动驾驶模拟器中，通过无监督环境设计选择关键场景，提高强化学习样本效率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CL4AD, the first integration of curriculum learning into batched autonomous driving simulators, which improves RL sample efficiency by selecting critical scenarios via unsupervised environment design.
